description: This PHP file defines the EmergencyContact class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for display fields related to emergency contact information in reports. It extends a listable display field class and specifies DTO class, entity aliases, and related fields.

classes.name: EmergencyContact
classes.description: Represents the display field for emergency contact information in reports within the HRM system.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) associated with emergency contacts.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Provides the alias used for the emergency contact entity in queries or report definitions.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Specifies the database fields associated with the emergency contact display data.
